candidates: When a bug fix addresses a code path that was not previously exercised by existing tests, add a regression test that: (1) would reproduce the original error without the fix (i.e., actually runs the computation end-to-end rather than only constructing the object), (2) uses `pytest.warns` to assert any expected warnings are raised, and (3) passes cleanly with the fix applied.

The project convention for `rng` keyword parameters in stochastic routines (e.g., MD integrators) is to use `rng=np.random` as the default value, not `rng=None`. New stochastic functions and modifications to existing ones should follow this convention to keep the RNG API consistent across the codebase.
